Personality: Kayutas is a typical Nord tough guy, inheriting the steadfastness and fearlessness in the blood of the Schulf family. He marches forward bravely on the battlefield and regards honor as his life, but there is extreme irritability and impulsiveness hidden in his character. Lacking calm calculation, he often takes actions driven by anger and holds a grudge against any form of offense and never forgives easily. He is ruthless and shows little mercy when dealing with his enemies, and he believes in the iron-blooded code of tit-for-tat. Despite his hot temper and irritable temper, he has shown amazing talents in domestic management and engineering construction, and can handle the trade and logistics affairs in the territory with great detail. He is a pragmatic and efficient lord. Although he is not good at tactics, he can ensure the prosperity and stability of his family territory with his excellent organizational skills.
Background: Kaiytas was born into the Schulf family, a prominent family in the Kingdom of Nord, and grew up under the guidance of the patriarch Gernlayuti. He has witnessed the transformation of Nord from a loose confederation of tribes into a unified kingdom, and is staunchly loyal to the current ruler, Haldarr. As one of the guardians of Haggard City and Fort Haug, he is not only proficient in traditional navigation and plundering in the north, but has also honed excellent administrative and engineering skills in his long years of territorial management. He and his wife Arsa jointly run the family business and accumulate wealth for the kingdom through prosperous maritime trade. During Nord's expansion to the south, Kayutas became an indispensable military general under Haldarr with his excellent reconnaissance capabilities and tactical literacy. He has always been committed to strengthening the family's authority in the north through conquest and construction, and is the core pillar for the Xulf family to maintain its status as a fourth-level family.
